02 — Flagship Project

Built to demonstrate government ICT relevance

FLAGSHIP DEMONSTRATION PROJECT

CivicAI Desk — AI-Assisted Public Service Request Router

Independent prototype built from scratch. Not affiliated with, commissioned by, or deployed within any government agency.

A citizen describes an issue in plain language below. A lightweight, explainable rule-based classifier detects the likely department and flags a priority based on urgency language, then adds it to a live status board — the same routing problem behind platforms like e-Citizen and county Huduma centres, solved with transparent rules rather than a black box.

Prototype only — in-memory demo data, resets on page reload. Built in plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript, no framework or paid dependency.
civicai-desk — live triage demo 3 requests logged
Try: "large pothole near the school gate" or "how do I renew my business permit?"
